verdict.rationale: Government digital services can publish their source under an open license, so this axis applies to the Department's eServices. However, the evidence shows nothing about source code or licensing. The downloadable XML schemas and XPath package are integration specifications, not product source, and the batch-enrollment specifications require an email request. The probed business-tax application is an authenticated login shell.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
